correction_query.effective_pool: new response only; never union with original d12 pool

acquisition.credentials: none; public keyless GitHub request only for the corrective query
acquisition.prior_receipts: All 13 original query receipts and 37 physical HTTP request/response sidecars are immutable, hash-bound historical inputs; not fresh calls or time credit in this stage.
acquisition.reused_effective_inputs: d1-d11 and d13 exactly as pinned (12 pools); d12 original receipt retained as history but excluded from effective pool.
acquisition.scope_exception: Explicitly permits evaluation with complete received research pools despite retained blocked Wikipedia outcomes; other missing/partial/empty/overflow outcomes remain failures and are never substituted.
acquisition.unavailable_outcome: retain original blocked outcomes as unavailable; do not synthesize success or drop source cards/outcomes

adoption: No production adoption from this development stage. Separate untouched confirmation and full product delivery remain required.

candidate.contract: Exact EXP-076 canonical complete-pool dual Score populations and equal-weight Fraction RRF k60. Same query/purpose instructions, criteria, model, projection and tie rule; only fresh caller task/pool data differ.
candidate.phase_includes: fresh construction/serialization, exchange, parsing/fusion, final receipt fsync

capture.assessment_scope: Complete eligible source inventory with a frozen first-8000-Unicode-character view per successful capture, prepared before selector output. Full raw capture remains private; retain both full and bounded context hashes and truncation flags. This is not exhaustive full-document factual review.
capture.budget_scope: Owned experimental requests only: <=640 scrape requests plus one read-only candidate health request. Candidate-internal HTTP fanout is not bounded by this figure and is unknown unless separately exposed.
capture.internal_service_calls: observe where exposed; otherwise explicitly unknown, not counted as zero
capture.raw_content_publication: private evidence storage; public sanitized hashes/aggregates only
capture.source_url_admission: Use pinned public retrieval URL validator; reject userinfo, private/local/numeric-private destinations before dispatch. HTTPS-only capture follows the prior source-use capture contract; unsupported URLs remain recorded unavailable, never rewritten or replaced. Hostname DNS aliases additionally depend on candidate scraper SSRF controls.

confirmation_scope.wikipedia: excluded prospectively as unavailable; future three-engine confirmation is not comparable to earlier four-engine studies

consumer.alias_limitations: record configured and returned model identity; do not assert immutable checkpoint equivalence
consumer.source_availability_and_ordering: apply same dedup/refusal/video/availability policy to each fixed top-ten order; preserve failed openings separately

fresh_stage_scope.covers: corrective acquisition, capture, selector, answer generation, assessor grading, analysis and durable receipts

grading_order: verify immutable reused receipts and the one corrective query
freeze complete effective pools and source captures
run neutral and fixed selector comparisons
verify receipts and compute every frozen endpoint

jev_invocation.call_slots: neutral capacity pair plus 13 base and 8 repeat/rotate operation pairs

models.answer_calls_basis: 16 task/arm answers plus 2 declared neutral readiness checks
models.answer_provider_surface: Existing explicitly configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP/HTTPS origin or /v1 base; normalized to one /v1/chat/completions path. Endpoint/key remain private runtime configuration read only after qualified admission.
models.card_and_source_and_answer_assessors: GPT-6 Luna, independent anonymous packets; not human gold
models.reported_usage: retain where exposed; in-app grader billing/tokens may be unobservable, never invent them

purpose: Development-only bounded study under the maintainer-approved acquisition amendment. No production adoption or confirmation-stage execution.
stop: Any source/input integrity failure, unregistered request, budget/deadline breach, missing required endpoint, or incomplete grade stops the run with retained partial evidence; no retries, rescue, tuning, replacement or automatic confirmation.

task_use.assessor_disagreements: separate endpoints, never average into a pass
task_use.completion: all declared critical checks supported, applicable and correctly applied to delivered evidence; model self-certification is insufficient
task_use.source_unavailability: recorded in denominators; not-acquired is an observed state, not automatically a structural packet error
task_use.uncertainty_report: Paired task bootstrap of completion-count difference, 10000 draws, seed7701; descriptive only, no additional significance gate.
